question.text:
A tin chloride Q undergoes the following reactions (not balanced)
Q+Cl-→X
Q+Me3N→Y
Q+CuCl2→Z+CuCl
X is a monoanion having pyramidal geometry. Both Y and Z are neutral compounds. Choose the correct option(s).

options.text: The central atoms in X is  <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math>  hybridized
The oxidation state of the central atom in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></math>  is  <math><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></math>
The central atom in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></math>  has one lone pair of electrons
There is a coordinate bond in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math>

solution.text:
Sn has vacant d orbitals in tin(II)chloride which can be used to accommodate electron pairs and form coordinate bond.

LP = Lone pairs

X is mono anion with sp3 hybridisation and It has trigonal pyramidal geometry.

The above reaction is a Lewis acid-base reaction. The adduct Y formed is a coordination compound, and it is a neutral compound.

The central atom in Z is tin, its oxidation state is +4, and it has no lone pair electrons. Z is a neutral compound.
